_comment: Parametric board definition for build_board.py, zones from mechanical/out/v010/OP-100.layout.json (merged 2026-11-19). Board frame: bx right, by up, viewed from the TOP (lid side); KiCad frame x=bx, y=H-by. x_pod = x_r1 + 2.6 + bx, y_pod = 1.5 + by. outline.w is the parameter (mechanical v010 outline is 44.25 mm long with a notch x<9.4,y<18.8; this variant adds a tail beyond x 44.85).

dock_insert_reserve.note: dock tunnel: insert and dome path under the board, only the dock halls (0.4 mm pocket) below; top parts <= 1.3 mm

battery_bay.note: 301012 class cell 13.5 x 10.2 x 3.2; only the 2 SMD spring contacts below

spindle_magnet_strip.note: TMAG5273 under the spindle magnet only

notch.note: bench-pod notch (reservoir end, magnet); keep clear on both sides

antenna_keepout.note: E73 ceramic antenna end, both sides
